name: Countdown Moment
descriptionTemplate: {Team Unique}: At the start of exploration, add 1 card {5: Countdown} to the deck. {5: Countdown}: Draw 1 card after played, shuffle the next {Countdown} into the Discard Pile, {Destroy}. {0: Countdown}: Draw 3 cards, gain 3 Arithmetica, and have a [StateArg1]% chance to shuffle {5: Countdown} into the Discard Pile, {Retain}, {Destroy}.
lore:
In the new year, you decided to hold an unprecedented ceremony to welcome the passage of time.

You had been preparing for it for a long time. You lit candles, letting their warm glow illuminate the winter night on campus. You erected a high platform at the center of the training ground and covered it with deep-red velvet cloth adorned with intricate patterns. You even cut countless colorful ribbons by hand, wrapping them in gold foil and silver gauze. You hoped to transform the melancholy of farewell into an everlasting moment embraced by both the departing year and the new one.

But something was still missing.

You ventured deep into the old warehouse, brushing away layers of dust, and finally found an antique clock. Its casing was worn, and its hands had long since broken off and fallen away under the erosion of time. It was clearly unusable.

Just as you were at your wits' end, Thais appeared, standing quietly behind a brand-new clock.

The clock seemed strangely familiar. Thais still wore her playful smile, but a gentle certainty shone in her eyes.

"What do you think? This clock, paired with my dance, will surely make this the grandest ceremony ever."

"This... isn't Tawil's clock, is it?"

"Oh, you know she's been all alone in the pool. It must be terribly dull for her."

"Letting her join our ceremony and feel my love might spark her interest a little~"

Midnight arrived quietly, and Thais stood before the giant clock like a gift wrapped in time itself.

Ribbons swirled around her like unfired fireworks, forming golden-red and silver-blue ripples in the flowing light. The plump bow at her waist was the final knot tied by the new year. She was the grandest gift of the year's end, wrapped in joyful satin and waiting for time to unseal her.

Her arms rose slowly, her fingertips tracing the light and shadows before finally pointing toward the clock hanging behind her. Twelve numbers formed a halo around the clock face, dancing at her fingertips.

The congregation watched Thais's exuberant dance, seemingly infected by the joyous atmosphere, and began to sway along with her.

When the final chime rang out, she lightly tapped the clock with one fingertip, touching the beginning of eternity. The bound gift opened its arms, transforming all the celebration stored at the year's end into a shower of blessings that scattered across the world.
